_offer_query_doc: Scratch training here is CPU-bound: the trainer takes half the container's CPUs for physics. A 16-thread 3090 box ran the incumbent recipe at ~36k steps/s (2026-10-20, smoke_x1) against ~420k on the 5090 PC, so boxes need >= 32 effective threads on a fast CPU.
